title: N=1000 full-book LaTeX source generation timing
method: Run scripts/benchmark_book.py three times with the current renderer, synthetic media enabled, and PDF compilation disabled. Record the benchmark's full-book latex_seconds value; it covers generation of the complete LaTeX source, not only the citation appendix.
interpretation: Python generation of the entire 4.04 MB LaTeX source is about 0.98 seconds, roughly 0.19% of the recent 514.058-second optimized N=1000 PDF compilation median. This is an indicative scale comparison across benchmark runs, not an isolated citation-appendix measurement. Further Python-side micro-optimization is unlikely to materially reduce PDF export time; the remaining performance work belongs in LuaLaTeX composition and page output.
